rv.q: ...gut punch of a show remains a beautiful piece of theatre for all audiences...

“For Black Boys,” with its didactic enumeration of societal ills, has the feel of a PowerPoint presentation; its bracing directness befits the urgency of its message, but as a piece of art it never quite transports us.

cn.t: Critics praise this gut-punch exploration of Black male bonding as beautiful and generous theatre, though reception ranges from deeply moved to more measured appreciation.
